market.literal: By Dec31 2026 ET the U.S. federal government must issue a waiver/license/termination/revocation/equivalent that lifts any part of CAATSA §231 penalties on Turkey, SSB, or covered Turkish officials. Intent, negotiations and F-35/NDAA-only changes do not qualify.

current_ofac_page.page_observation: Official current CAATSA program page identifies §231 and links to State. Its listed recent CAATSA actions are Feb24 2026 (Russia-related), Nov19 2025 (Russia-related), and Jul1 2025 (Russia-related). Captured body contains no literal Turkey or SSB string. The page’s recent-action list is not a complete record of every State-issued instrument.

linked_state_page_attempt.limit: The ordinary GET raised HTTPError and capture adapter retained status=null/body empty; exact HTTP status is unknown. No retry/bypass.

existing_valid_history: data/deep_review_20261017/work/0391_facts.json records the 2020 SSB/four-official sanctions notice and a Federal Register April 2026 recital that SSB was subject to §231 sanctions as of July9 2024. Those are dated historical facts, not a current October2026 relief status.
bounded_search: One official-domain query for Treasury/State Turkey CAATSA §231 relief returned the OFAC program page and archived statutory/older material; no fresh Turkey relief instrument was identified in the returned results. Search representation has no raw HTTP receipt. This does not prove no instrument exists or cover all relevant government records.
finding: No current qualifying relief instrument was established in this bounded refresh. OFAC page evidence is limited to its linked program page/recent-actions list; linked State page access failed with status unrecorded. Negotiation/issuance status remains unresolved; no absence inference.
